Signed Binary Notice • Why Windows SmartScreen Still Prompts Temporarily

100% Cryptographically Signed: Every official RaggieSoft Studio download—including Universal Web & Offline Setup.exe launchers, inner x64 & ARM64 .msi databases, Installer Studio v0.5.0, and Accessibility Studio v1.0.0—is Dual-Layer Authenticode-signed via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Verified publisher: Michael Ragsdale, RFC 3161 timestamped, and verified with signtool verify /pa).

Why SmartScreen may still say “Windows protected your PC” right now: Our Microsoft Public Trust signing certificate is brand-new (issued November 25, 2026). Under Microsoft’s current SmartScreen rules, newly issued certificates start at zero download reputation until initial install volume and Microsoft Security Intelligence (WDSI) review complete (already submitted). To install safely while reputation clears: click More info, confirm Windows shows Publisher: Michael Ragsdale (never “Unknown publisher”), and click Run anyway. Full details in the FAQ →

Preview Upcoming Showcase Studio & Launcher Studio Concepts

Showcase Studio Runtime • 1990s .BMP Mode + WCAG 2.2 AA Safeguards

1990s Painted .BMP CD-ROM Showcase — Upgraded with Modern Accessibility

In the 1990s, painted bitmap menus were completely inaccessible to blind, low-vision, and keyboard-only users because buttons were just flat pixels on a single background image. Showcase Studio solves this cleanly in Win32 C++20: authors place rectangular or polygon hotspots over any retro .BMP/.PNG canvas, and the runtime creates real windowless/child UI Automation Button peers with Alt+Key mnemonics, dual black/gold high-contrast focus frames, and automatic OS Contrast Theme fallback.
Showcase Studio Runtime • Windows 11 FluentMica 16:9 Mode

Modern Windows 11 FluentMica 16:9 Collector’s Edition Launchpad

Designed for USB box sets, downloadable ISO collector editions, multi-package suite front-ends, offline press kits, and museum or classroom kiosks—booting in under 40ms from static /MT C++20 on x64 and ARM64 with zero browser engine bloat.
LauncherStudio.exe • White-Label Desktop Hub & Static-CDN Updater IDE

LauncherStudio.exe — Branded Desktop App Hub & Catalog Compiler

Publish a static signed catalog.json alongside your .msi, .msp, or RaggieScript EXE (Engine = raggiescript) packages on any HTTPS server, S3 bucket, or Cloudflare R2 bucket—zero database servers to maintain, zero forced customer logins, and mandatory SHA-256 + WinVerifyTrust signature verification before any update executes.
